key_metric: Technical Solutions (ATS) segment operating profit/margin in the Q3 release, and whether management reaffirms FY26 adjusted EPS of $3.85-$4.15 without narrowing it. H1 FY26 adjusted EPS was $1.73, exactly flat vs H1 FY25's $1.73, so the reaffirmed guide requires an H2 of $2.12-$2.42 vs a prior-year H2 of $1.70 (+25% to +42%). ATS margin was 3.7% in Q1 FY26 vs 7.8% in Q3 FY25; Q3 ATS operating profit below ~$22M kills the guide, above ~$28M validates it.

notes.event_window_correction: The task framing described the window as 'after the US close on Monday 07 September 2026'. Monday 2026-09-07 is Labor Day and US equity markets are closed; the last traded session is Friday 2026-09-04. All price, IV and positioning figures are as-of the 2026-09-04 close by construction.
notes.fiscal_period_correction: This is fiscal Q3 2026 (quarter ended 2026-07-31), not Q4. ABM's fiscal year ends 31 October.
notes.implied_move_methodology: 7.5% is the ATM straddle for the first expiry after the report (2026-09-18, 14 calendar days, ATM IV 47.7%), per the standard convention. Because ABM has no weekly options, that expiry sits 10 trading days after the event and therefore includes non-event vol. A two-expiry decomposition (Sep-18 vs Oct-16) isolates an earnings-jump sigma of 6.77%, i.e. an expected absolute event-day move of ~5.4%. The panel should treat both as wide-error-bar estimates: total front-expiry open interest is 93 contracts.
notes.options_liquidity_warning: Stage 0 recorded an 'active listed options market'. That is an overstatement. ABM has monthly expiries only, $5 strike spacing, quotes as wide as 0.15 bid / 1.15 offered on the front ATM call, 93 contracts of open interest at the 2026-09-18 expiry and 3,157 across all eight listed expiries.
notes.historical_moves_note: historical_moves_pct lists 12 quarters, most recent first (Q2 FY26 back to Q3 FY23). The mean/median/max fields describe the last 6 quarters only. Last 12: mean abs 7.58, median abs 7.51, max abs 17.90, 6 up / 6 down. Report dates were taken from SEC 8-K Item 2.02 filing dates and moves computed by me from stockanalysis daily closes; all ABM releases are BMO so the reaction day is the filing date.
notes.run_in_signal: Across the 12 events the 10-session run-in correlates +0.68 with the reaction (5-session +0.67). The current run-in is flat (-0.32% 5d, +0.51% 10d, -3.09% 21d), which argues for a muted, unbiased reaction and is the strongest single argument against a large directional move.
notes.vol_context: Realised 21-day vol is 14.9%, the 4th percentile of the last two years (2y range 9.9 / 24.2 median / 51.9). Front-expiry ATM IV of 47.7% sits far above it. IV rank could not be sourced, but the absolute vol risk premium is unusually wide.
notes.headline_vs_reality_trap: FY26 guidance is stated 'before any impact from prior-year self-insurance adjustments' while reported adjusted EPS, after an SEC-comment-driven definitional change implemented 2025-12-17, now includes them. Consensus is a reported-basis number. In Q4 FY25 a $(0.26) prior-year self-insurance impact produced a $0.88 print against a $1.09 consensus - a 19% headline miss - and the stock closed +5.49%. If the panel sees a large EPS miss on 2026-09-08, check the self-insurance line first.
